raw_text: Red Alert: Our sources in Burha Pahar area reported unusual Maoist movement 3 days ago. Village-level informers mentioned forced food collection and mobilisation of dalam members. We shared this with local CRPF post but response was delayed. The attack was planned — this was not random. CPI(Maoist) special area committee has been active in this corridor for months. They used a culvert IED similar to the 2019 pattern.
